Finding: Primary call-to-action and core offer headline are unclear above the fold
Evidence: Hero headline "Innovative Solutions Built for Modern Enterprise" uses abstract slogans without declaring the facility maintenance trade or commercial focus.
Business Impact: Visitors may leave without inquiring because they cannot determine what the company provides within the first 5 seconds.
Recommended Action: Rewrite hero to: "Commercial Facility Maintenance & HVAC with Guaranteed 2-Hour Regional Dispatch."

Finding: Three competing action buttons appear in the header and hero with equal visual weight
Evidence: Buttons for "Explore Services", "Download Corporate Brochure", and "Contact Us" fight for attention above the fold.
Business Impact: Corporate facility managers seeking urgent dispatch experience decision friction and bounce.
Recommended Action: Consolidate competing options into one high-contrast primary "Request Immediate Service" button and move the brochure to the footer.

Finding: Verified facility customer reviews and safety credentials are buried below the fold
Evidence: Zero ratings, commercial client logos, or trade certifications (OSHA, EPA, NATE) are visible in the initial 800px viewport.
Business Impact: First-time commercial buyers cannot verify company scale or reliability, increasing perceived operational risk.
Recommended Action: Add a prominent trust bar showing "4.9★ from 350+ Facilities • OSHA & NATE Certified" directly under the primary CTA.

Finding: Mobile phone numbers are rendered as unclickable plain text on smartphone viewports
Evidence: Header phone "(555) 234-5678" cannot be tapped directly on iOS/Android; lacks active tel: hyperlink.
Business Impact: On-site managers on mobile devices looking for emergency repair must manually copy/dial, risking lost inquiries.
Recommended Action: Convert all phone instances to tap-to-call links and add a sticky mobile bottom action bar.

Finding: Transparent service rate guidance and emergency intake SLA steps are missing
Evidence: No baseline hourly rates or structured 3-step "Dispatch Timeline" provided on service pages.
Business Impact: Inquirers uncertain about dispatch turnaround or unexpected overage costs often hesitate to call.
Recommended Action: Add a 3-step dispatch process: 1. Work Order Intake → 2. Tech En Route (<2hr) → 3. Status Tracking.
